fingerprint_mode: deterministic task record only; no owner-curated semantic fields
corpus_rule: Completed TASK-160 through TASK-205, excluding non-completed TASK-186.

retrieval_contract.delivery_mode: one query packet at a time
retrieval_contract.helper_access: current query packet only; no index, truth set, broad search, or named-source reads

queries.question: I want to reconstruct what happened across earlier work into a throwaway database I can inspect, and know when it has gone out of date compared with the real records. Which work did that?
source_justifications: Builds the disposable SQLite read model, records source high-water metadata and drift findings, and exposes task, agent, trace, and status queries.
Proves deterministic queries plus unsafe status on malformed events, missing task references, and mirror-validation failures.

queries.question: Links between our markdown documents were not being picked up when the pointer used a whole-project prefix or just a neighbouring file's name. What fixed that lookup?
source_justifications: Contains the multi-base related-bullet resolver and the conversion path that consumes it.
Covers repository-root-relative paths, source-directory sibling paths, end-to-end conversion, and intentional Guidelines exclusion.

queries.question: How do we stop secrets from leaking into saved logs while still keeping the log entry itself?
source_justifications: Defines known-secret patterns, false-positive guards, placeholder replacement, and warn-and-redact behavior before persistence.
Exercises credential families, entropy true and false positives, idempotence, warnings, and on-disk capture integration.

queries.question: What stops two people grabbing the same item for checking at the same time, and also stops whoever did the work from signing it off themselves?
source_justifications: Provides atomic review claiming, open-claim lookup, self-review rejection, and holder-only release behavior.
Proves one-winner review races, self-review rejection, submitted-status gating, and release by the actual holder.

queries.question: Can an automated check actually stop work rather than only warn, and how is that power kept switched off unless deliberately turned on, with an expiry?
source_justifications: Shows the halt-authority window with no expiry grant and empty scope, making the live default disabled.
Proves disabled, expired, and scope-mismatched windows only log, while active scoped windows create operator-clearable halts.

queries.question: How does the project tracker let someone save a copy of their data and load it back later, refuse a bad file, and warn before replacing what is already there?
source_justifications: Implements separate backup controls, a full-model envelope, import normalization, overwrite confirmation, save, and re-render while retaining exportStatus.
Records a real export-clear-import round trip preserving omitted fields and a malformed-JSON check leaving storage unchanged.

queries.question: Where can I see how much effort went in versus what actually shipped or was thrown away, without invented money figures?
source_justifications: Joins event volume, activity span, attempts, and rework with explicit outcome classes and productive, abandoned, pending, and legacy buckets.
Records the real repository run, proxy disclaimer, class definitions, spend split, JSON summary, and caveats.

queries.question: The automatic wake-up message sometimes goes to a worker that never stopped, and sometimes it freezes while bringing one back. Which finished work handled both of those?
source_justifications: Detects the still-active resume response and sends to the live session while separately catching resume timeouts and returning failure.
Distinguishes visible-terminal resume, active-session fallback success/failure, and timeout behavior for both task IDs.
queries.ambiguity: Compound label: TASK-187 covers already-active fallback and TASK-195 covers resume timeouts; neither alone is complete.

note: Controlled probe: identical corpus/expected truth; only question wording changed to non-corpus vocabulary.
